Trains to Cosford

This is the train I would look at for the RAF Cosford Air Show. Cosford station sits right beside the airfield on the Wolverhampton to Shrewsbury line, under 300 metres from the entrance. West Midlands Railway runs the trains from Birmingham New Street and Wolverhampton, and in 2026 there were extra trains and extra Transport for Wales stops on show day. Just bear in mind the station has steps and no step free access, and it gets very busy.
